name: The Straight Run
tagline: Give the robot its first instruction.
narrative: A robot sits at the entrance of a straight corridor, facing the exit. It has no rules, so it will wait indefinitely. Give it a movement rule for a clear path and an arrival rule that keeps it on the goal long enough for the maze to confirm completion.
objective: Get the robot to the exit at the far end of the corridor and hold there for 3 ticks.
learningObjective: Understand a rule as a WHEN condition paired with a DO action, and understand that the first matching rule runs.
intelligenceExplanation: The brain starts empty. Add an arrival rule first and a clear-path movement rule beneath it. Every tick the engine reads the rules from top to bottom and runs the first matching safe action. The maze completes after the robot remains on the goal for 3 consecutive ticks.
hint: Two rules. Put WHEN atGoal -> DO hold first, then add WHEN there is no wall ahead -> DO step.
hints: The robot only acts when a rule tells it to. It needs at least one rule.
Add a rule: WHEN there is no wall ahead → DO step.
Put WHEN atGoal → DO hold above it so it settles once it arrives.
brief: Move through the straight corridor and remain on the exit for 3 ticks.
context: The robot has movement primitives but begins with no rules.

steps.label: Give the robot a rule for a clear path
Reach the exit and settle on it

goals.description: Reach the exit of the corridor.

objectives.label: Reach the exit and settle on it
Solve it with 2 rules or fewer
